en.shortDescription: Self-hosted DevOps platform with Git, CI/CD, and registry
en.longDescription:
GitLab Community Edition is a complete DevOps platform delivered as a single application.

Includes Git repositories, issue tracking, CI/CD pipelines, and container registry. First boot is slow and production use requires at least 4 GB RAM.

de.shortDescription: Self-Hosted-DevOps-Plattform mit Git, CI/CD und Registry
de.longDescription:
GitLab Community Edition ist eine vollständige DevOps-Plattform als einzelne Anwendung.

Enthält Git-Repositories, Issue-Tracking, CI/CD-Pipelines und Container-Registry. Der erste Start ist langsam; für den Produktionseinsatz werden mindestens 4 GB RAM benötigt.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme DevOps auto-hébergée avec Git, CI/CD et registre
fr.longDescription:
GitLab Community Edition est une plateforme DevOps complète livrée comme une application unique.

Inclut les dépôts Git, le suivi des issues, les pipelines CI/CD et le registre de conteneurs. Le premier démarrage est lent et l'utilisation en production nécessite au moins 4 Go de RAM.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma DevOps auto-hospedada com Git, CI/CD e registry
pt.longDescription:
GitLab Community Edition é uma plataforma DevOps completa entregue como uma única aplicação.

Inclui repositórios Git, rastreamento de issues, pipelines CI/CD e registro de contêineres. O primeiro boot é lento e o uso em produção exige pelo menos 4 GB de RAM.
